sources.facts: Twenty-six outer Ionic columns, twelve in the north portico and sixteen at the four inner openings; marble exterior and granite steps; bronze statue on a dark granite pedestal.

Portico approximately 31.09 m wide and 13.72 m deep; unfluted Ionic columns, central statue approximately 5.79 m on 1.83 m pedestal. General height statements conflict with the later measured drawing and are not used as exact controls.

sources.inspection: HABS 1994 north elevation viewed in browser, including enlarged dimension chain: stylobate to architrave 41 ft 0 7/8 in; stylobate to upper terrace wall 8 ft 5 1/8 in. Dome, steps, eight-column portico, pediment and flat parapet relationship inspected.

HABS 1994 longitudinal section viewed in browser, enlarged vertical chain: main floor to attic 50 ft 7 1/4 in and attic to dome top 45 ft 1 in. Separate inner dome and stepped outer shell, chamber openings, raised floors and stair landings inspected. Approximate datum is chosen at the mapped main flight, not the distant basin edge.
